claim_boundary: This policy derives a candidate model-role map from the preregistered E001 evidence. It does not qualify dynamics or assert that the modeled sensory drive equals measured activity in these neurons.

side_inference.ambiguous_policy: exclude from side-specific model roles and report
side_inference.rationale: Ventral PFN airflow preference is tied to the hemisphere of the cell body, so MaleCNS somaSide is the primary side authority when present.

odor_context_left.rationale: FB5AB is the E001 literature-anchored odor-sensitive FB tangential input; task v1 injects the same nondirectional odor-context value bilaterally.

odor_context_right.rationale: Right-side counterpart of the tied bilateral FB5AB odor-context role.

wind_basis_left.rationale: Retained ventral-PFN source neurons assigned to the left airflow basis only when somaSide, rootSide, or the instance fallback resolves their hemisphere as left.

wind_basis_right.rationale: Right-side counterpart of the side-resolved retained ventral-PFN basis population.

steer_left.rationale: Left DNa02 is the bilateral high-gain steering readout; left DNa02 activity predicts leftward turning in direct recordings.

steer_right.rationale: Right counterpart of the DNa02 steering readout.

integration_hdelta_c.rationale: Exact hDeltaC body IDs retained by odor-input, PFN-input, and outgoing PFL3 stages.

pfl3_output.rationale: Exact PFL3 body IDs continuous across the hDeltaC-to-PFL3 and PFL3-to-DNa02 stages.

wind_unresolved_policy.reason: The optimizer must not invent hemisphere assignments for any retained PFN whose somaSide, rootSide, and instance evidence all fail to resolve side.

required_before_training: no body ID appears in both left and right versions of the same role family
exact role IDs and side evidence source are persisted
intermediate-type composition is summarized for each primary E001 stage
sign coverage is computed on the eventual candidate GraphBundle
review artifact is frozen before real optimization
